reasoning: Both audits correctly identified the package as safe. PKGBUILD uses verified GitHub sources with pinned commits and checksums, while kytyps5.desktop is a standard desktop entry. No executable hooks or build scripts exist beyond PKGBUILD.
coverage_issues: qwen model reviewed only 2 files (PKGBUILD/desktop), missing .gitlab-ci.yml which could theoretically modify packaging behavior
Neither model reviewed qt.conf (potential runtime config) though low-risk in binary package context
false_positives: deepseek's review of CMake/header files: These are upstream artifacts unused during install (AUR guideline §4)
deepseek's .gitlab-ci.yml review: CI configs don't execute during makepkg (AUR guideline §3)
learnings: Improve file prioritization: Binary packages should focus exclusively on PKGBUILD, install hooks, and desktop files. Suppress CI/config/source file reviews unless referenced in PKGBUILD functions.
Fix selection failures: deepseek's empty response during file selection caused fallback to irrelevant files (CMake/headers). Implement hardcoded binary-package file whitelist.
Clarify audit scope: Models should explicitly state why non-packaging files (e.g., headers) are excluded per AUR guidelines to avoid over-auditing.
